description: Write. Records one conversion or revenue event from your server side (trusted: sentWith secret_key), the same as POST /v1/event. It counts in analytics and revenue and is sent to webhooks subscribed to app.event, so it needs confirm: true; without it nothing is recorded and you get a preview. clickId ties it to the tap it came from (apps get it from the SDK). eventId (e.g. your order id) makes retries safe: the same eventId is stored once. Apps should send events with the SDKs, not this tool.

clickId.description: The tap this conversion came from

confirm.description: true to record it; omit or false to preview

currency.description: ISO currency, e.g. INR or USD

data.description: Up to 20 custom key-values for the app.event webhook (not stored with the event)

event.description: Event name, e.g. purchase or signup

linkId.description: The link, when there is no clickId

name: record_event
title: Record a conversion event
